newsitem.title: USA: Boston Partners launches second mutual fund.
newsitem.headline: Boston Partners launches second mutual fund.

text.p: Boston Partners Asset Management L.P. said Wednesday it has launched its second mutual fund, Boston Partners Mid Cap Value Fund.

Mid Cap Value Fund will invest at least 65 percent of its assets in a diversified portfolio, primarily in equity investments in the $200 million to $4 billion capitalization range. The fund is open to institutional and retail investors, with a minimum investment of $100,000 and $2,500 respectively.

Boston Partners, formed by former executives of Mellon Bank Corp's The Boston Company in April, 1995, launched Boston Partners Large Cap Value Fund in December. It now has $15 million in assets, Boston Partners said.
